rv.q: A Room with a View is an emotional journey; sweet, hopeful, undeniably romantic, ridiculously fun, and I would do it all again.
This excellent work ripples with joy and fun.
Ultimately, A Room with a View is an exceptionally funny production that revels in the possibilities of live theatre.
Elegant, engaging and refreshingly romantic, it is a fitting celebration of the freedom to follow one's heart.
A Room with a View is a smart, funny adaptation and with the shining central character of Lucy rightly bucking against the patriarchy, I think Forster might have loved it.

rv.o: I Tell You What I Think
rv.q: So it is that director Hannah Goodwin has ensured there are no shortage of surprises in this thoroughly entertaining adaptation of A Room with a View.
